nodes.title: Bound for the monic Chebyshev polynomial on the interval
The bound is attained at x = 1

nodes.summary: $2^{1-n} T_n$ has leading coefficient $1$, since $T_n$ has leading coefficient $2^{n-1}$ for $n \ge 1$.
nodes.title: The monic Chebyshev polynomial is monic

nodes.summary: The monic Chebyshev polynomial $2^{1-n} T_n$ of degree $n$ (equal to $1$ for $n = 0$), where $T_n(\cos\theta) = \cos(n\theta)$.
nodes.title: Monic Chebyshev polynomial

nodes.summary: A monic real polynomial $p$ of degree $n$ with $|p(x)| \le 2^{1-n}$ for every $x \in [-1, 1]$ equals $2^{1-n} T_n$.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the Chebyshev minimax polynomial

nodes.summary: If $p$ is a monic real polynomial of degree $n$ and $|p(x)| \le M$ for every $x \in [-1, 1]$, then $M \ge 2^{1-n}$. Among monic polynomials of degree $n$, none is smaller on $[-1, 1]$ than $2^{1-n} T_n$.
nodes.title: Minimax property of the Chebyshev polynomials

nodes.summary: The least $M$ such that some monic real polynomial of degree $n$ satisfies $|p| \le M$ on $[-1, 1]$ is exactly $2^{1-n}$, attained by $2^{1-n} T_n$.
